morning_starts.title: Coffee at FLUID Roasters
morning_starts.note: Get the Voodoo Latte. 518 Franklin St.

morning_starts.title: Breakfast at Sophia's
morning_starts.note: Go early — 5-egg omelets, Nutella crepes. Open 363 days/yr.

morning_starts.title: Brunch at Leeds Public House
morning_starts.note: Weekend brunch, fire pit patio, Nashville Hot Chicken Mac.

morning_starts.title: Coffee at Basecamp Marina
morning_starts.note: Coffee with a waterfront view at the marina.

morning_starts.title: Breakfast at Memo's
morning_starts.note: Family-run. Chorizo scrambles, huevos rancheros, homemade salsa.

morning_starts.title: Coffee at Lakeshore Café
morning_starts.note: Quick stop near the outlets before a shopping morning.

beach_lake_outdoor.title: Washington Park Beach
beach_lake_outdoor.note: 2 miles of sand. Walk the pier to the 1904 lighthouse. Parking $15.

beach_lake_outdoor.title: Indiana Dunes — Mount Baldy hike
beach_lake_outdoor.note: Closest big dune access. Stunning lake views from the top. $25/vehicle.

beach_lake_outdoor.title: 3 Dune Challenge at Dunes State Park
beach_lake_outdoor.note: Mt. Tom, Mt. Holden, Mt. Jackson. Brutal but worth it.

beach_lake_outdoor.title: Rent a pontoon boat
beach_lake_outdoor.note: No license needed. Half-day from Harbor Country Adventures.

beach_lake_outdoor.title: Sunset sail
beach_lake_outdoor.note: 2-hour captained cruise on a 34-ft sailboat. BYOB. Book for 2-6.

beach_lake_outdoor.title: Charter fishing — salmon/steelhead
beach_lake_outdoor.note: Fire Drill, Tightline, or Colorblind. Equipment provided, ~$650.

culture_history.title: Old Lighthouse Museum
culture_history.note: Indiana's oldest (1858). Climb to lantern room. $10.

culture_history.title: Lubeznik Center for the Arts
culture_history.note: 5 galleries, always free. Check for First Friday events.

culture_history.title: Uptown Arts District walk
culture_history.note: Galleries, vintage shops, Lange's meat market on Franklin St.

culture_history.title: Friendship Botanic Gardens
culture_history.note: 105 acres, 24+ gardens, from the 1933 World's Fair. $10.

culture_history.title: Michigan City Public Library
culture_history.note: Helmut Jahn architecture. Translucent walls, sawtooth roof. Free.

shopping_browsing.title: Lighthouse Place Premium Outlets
shopping_browsing.note: 70+ stores — Nike, Coach, North Face, Kate Spade. Grab the coupon book.

shopping_browsing.title: The Antique Market
shopping_browsing.note: 140+ dealers, most items under $100. Best Antique Shop 5 years running.

shopping_browsing.title: Uptown Arts District shopping
shopping_browsing.note: Good News Vintage, Hoity Toity, Ballyea Jewelry on Franklin.

shopping_browsing.title: Farmers Market (Saturday)
shopping_browsing.note: Producers-only, 8am-noon at 8th & Washington. Local honey, artisan bread.

shopping_browsing.title: Shady Creek Winery tasting
shopping_browsing.note: Local winery, nice grounds for an afternoon.

casual_lunch.title: Lunch at Swingbelly's
casual_lunch.note: Lake perch + Monday $5 burgers. Steps from the beach.

casual_lunch.title: Lunch at Fiddlehead
casual_lunch.note: Grass-fed burgers, great vegetarian options. No reservations.

casual_lunch.title: Lunch at Cool Runnings
casual_lunch.note: Jerk chicken, curry chicken, generous portions.

casual_lunch.title: Lunch at Leeds Public House
casual_lunch.note: Nashville Hot Chicken Mac, 14 local beers on tap.

casual_lunch.title: BBQ at Social Que
casual_lunch.note: Modern smoking, family recipes. Get there before they sell out.

casual_lunch.title: Pizza at Roma
casual_lunch.note: Family recipes 50+ years. Pizza, calzones, delivery.

happy_hour_drinks.title: Burn 'Em Brewing
happy_hour_drinks.note: 20+ beers on tap. Garbage Pail Nachos. Live music weekends.

happy_hour_drinks.title: Shoreline Brewery
happy_hour_drinks.note: World Beer Cup winner. One block from the lake.

happy_hour_drinks.title: Zorn Brew Works
happy_hour_drinks.note: Taco Tuesday is the move. Big indoor/outdoor space.

happy_hour_drinks.title: Ritz Klub Tavern
happy_hour_drinks.note: Oldest tavern since 1890s. Sunday Bloody Mary Bar.

happy_hour_drinks.title: Matey's Tiki Deck
happy_hour_drinks.note: 3-level Tiki Deck with lake views. Tropical cocktails.

dinner_casual.title: Dinner at Swingbelly's
dinner_casual.note: Lake perch + Monday $5 burgers. Steps from the beach.

dinner_casual.title: Dinner at Fiddlehead
dinner_casual.note: Grass-fed burgers, great vegetarian options. No reservations.

dinner_casual.title: Dinner at Cool Runnings
dinner_casual.note: Jerk chicken, curry chicken, generous portions.

dinner_casual.title: Dinner at Albano's Villa
dinner_casual.note: Sicilian family recipes since 1957. Red sauce heaven.

dinner_casual.title: Dinner at Leeds Public House
dinner_casual.note: Fire pit patio. Nashville Hot Chicken Mac.

dinner_upscale.title: Dinner at Farina's Supper Club
dinner_upscale.note: Book on OpenTable. Pork Chop Sinatra, spiked gelato.

dinner_upscale.title: Dinner at Galveston Steakhouse
dinner_upscale.note: Prime Rib ~$30, includes clam chowder & bread. No reservations.

dinner_upscale.title: Dinner at Patrick's Grille
dinner_upscale.note: Locally sourced, Lobster Bisque, Beef Tenderloins.

dinner_upscale.title: Dinner at Bridges Waterside Grille
dinner_upscale.note: Dockside on Trail Creek. Seasonal May-Sept. Elevated waterfront.

dinner_romantic.title: Sunset dinner at Bartlett's Fish Camp
dinner_romantic.note: Oyster bar, lobster rolls, 80 outdoor seats. THE spot.

dinner_romantic.title: Dinner at Farina's Supper Club
dinner_romantic.note: Chef Joseph Farina. Three private dining rooms. OpenTable.

dinner_romantic.title: Dinner at Bridges Waterside Grille
dinner_romantic.note: Dockside on Trail Creek. Seasonal May-Sept.

dinner_romantic.title: Dinner at Patrick's Grille
dinner_romantic.note: Refined American. White tablecloth without pretense.

dinner_romantic.title: Dinner at The Brewery Lodge
dinner_romantic.note: 12-suite manor on 40 wooded acres. Restaurant, Zorn beers.

nightlife.title: Stardust Event Center show
nightlife.note: National touring acts. Dinner + show packages.

nightlife.title: Live music at Burn 'Em Brewing
nightlife.note: Weekend bands on the patio. No cover.

nightlife.title: Rocks Lounge at Blue Chip
nightlife.note: Nightly live music inside the casino.

family_activities.title: Oasis Splash Pad + Washington Park Zoo
family_activities.note: Free zoo since 1928. Splash pad right next door.

family_activities.title: Lighthouse Place Outlets
family_activities.note: 70+ stores. Playground area. Coupon book at info center.

family_activities.title: Friendship Botanic Gardens
family_activities.note: 105 acres, Lake Lucerne, themed gardens. Great for a walk.

family_activities.title: Pancakes at Sophia's
family_activities.note: Mickey Mouse pancakes. You'll be a hero.

family_activities.title: Creek Ridge County Park
family_activities.note: Wetland boardwalks, disc golf, off-leash dog area.

rainy_day.title: Spa Blu at Blue Chip
rainy_day.note: 10,000 sq ft spa. Massage, facials, treatments.

rainy_day.title: Brewery crawl
rainy_day.note: Burn 'Em → Shoreline → Zorn. All indoors, all excellent.
